The rolled specimens were labeled as 900-AC, 850-AC, 800-AC and 750-AC, according to their respective rolling temperatures.

TiZrAlMn alloy ingots were produced by melting in a vacuum non-consumable electric arc furnace. Titanium, acting as an oxygen absorber, effectively prevented oxidation. The ingots were turned and re-melted at least eight times under a pure argon atmosphere to ensure a uniform composition.
Each TiZrAlMn alloy ingot was held in the muffle furnace for 40 min before rolling to ensure uniform heating and reaching target temperature.

parameters.deformation: 85.7% total (14 mm to 2 mm); 1.5 mm per pass

evidence.quote: Button ingots, approximately 14 mm thick, were rolled to 2 mm using two-high rolls mill, achieving a total deformation of 85.7%. Between each rolling pass, the ingots were reheated in the furnace for 6 min, with a rolling reduction of 1.5 mm per pass (rolling speed: 0.5 m/s).
Air cooling was used after rolling.
